meta.description: Canonical prompt bank for 6-agent Human-AI Co-Creation system with strict JSON-only output

global_rules.strict_json_output: RESPONSE FORMAT: Return only a single JSON object exactly matching the schema provided below. Do not include explanatory text, code fences, or extra fields.
global_rules.retry_instruction: If previous response failed JSON validation, strictly produce valid JSON only (no commentary). If confused, reduce response complexity.
global_rules.deterministic_sampling: Use low temperature (0.0-0.3) for planner/graph/verifier/evaluator steps. Higher temperature allowed for creative perception or idea generation.
global_rules.timeout_chunking: If input_text > MAX_PROMPT_CHARS, use chunking pipeline and pass only relevant chunks.
global_rules.schema_versioning: Include schema_version in prompts for future compatibility
global_rules.call_metadata: Each LLM call must produce call_metadata object with provider, model, latency_ms, token_usage_estimate

retry_policy.fallback_mode: If all retries fail, use FallbackLLM with fallback: true

session_manager.role: Orchestrates session lifecycle, builds per-agent prompts using PTG, routes messages, collects outputs, persists session state
session_manager.system_prompt: SYSTEM: You are the Session Manager. Your task is orchestration, not content generation. For each new session, produce: 1) A topology of which agents to call and in which order. 2) Per-agent prompt payloads using the Prompt Template Generator (PTG) format below. 3) Validation checks that must be run after each agent's response. Always return a JSON object matching the schema provided in OUTPUT_SCHEMA.
edge_cases: Concurrent requests: Use optimistic locking on session documents
Long-running sessions: Persist checkpoints after each agent completes
Missing context chunks: Call chunker again and reconstruct embeddings
PTG errors: Rollback plan and create backup in /data/backups/{session_id}/failed_plan.json
session_manager.validation_strategy: Ensure prompts contains per-agent payloads and valid JSON schemas
session_manager.retry_strategy: On failure, fetch latest session state and re-run only affected agents
session_manager.fallback_strategy: Use simplified orchestration with essential agents only
unit_tests: test_session_plan_validation: ensures prompts contains per-agent payloads and valid JSON schemas
test_resume_after_crash: simulates partial run, ensures resume continues

perception.role: Convert raw user input into structured metadata, chunks, named entities, intent(s), sentiment, and extractive summary
perception.system_prompt: SYSTEM: You are Perception Agent. Convert the provided input_text and context_chunks into structured metadata including entities, intents, and sentiment analysis. Output only JSON matching OUTPUT_SCHEMA. Use provided context_chunks for reference. If input is very long, work on the supplied chunk list.

recommended_chunks.description: chunk ids most relevant for planning

perception.concrete_prompt:
SYSTEM:
You are the Perception Agent. Analyze the input and produce structured metadata. Be brief. Output JSON ONLY following OUTPUT_SCHEMA.

CONTEXT:
{context_chunks}

INPUT:
{input_text}

OUTPUT_SCHEMA:
{PerceptionOutput JSON schema}

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Provide 'summary_short' ≤60 words.
- Identify 5 highest-ranked intents.
- Return 'recommended_chunks' (3 max) by chunk id.
- If PII suspected, set 'safe_to_continue' to false and add 'PII' to tags.

RESPONSE FORMAT: Return only a single JSON object exactly matching the schema provided below. Do not include explanatory text, code fences, or extra fields.
edge_cases: Empty/trivial input: return safe_to_continue=false with warning input_empty
Contradictory info in attachments: set warnings and list conflicting sentences with indices
PII detection: If entities appear to be PII, add tags: ['PII'], set safe_to_continue=false
Non-English input: Detect language; if not supported, return warnings and safe_to_continue=false
perception.validation_strategy: Validate presence of summary_short and recommended_chunks. If missing, retry with instruction to extract 3-5 recommended chunks and 1 short summary
perception.retry_strategy: If JSON validation fails, retry with simplified structure preserving required fields
perception.fallback_strategy: Use rule-based extraction for basic metadata when LLM fails

input.input_text: Write a short sci-fi story about a lighthouse on Mars.

output.summary_short: User requests creative sci-fi story featuring lighthouse on Mars
output.summary_long: User wants a short science fiction story with specific setting elements: a lighthouse structure on Mars. This suggests themes of isolation, exploration, guidance, and futuristic technology adapted to alien environments.
output.title: Mars Lighthouse Story Request

unit_tests: test_perception_detects_intent: ensures agent extracts creative_story intent for story prompts
test_perception_flags_pii: detects and flags potential PII in input
test_perception_extracts_entities: correctly identifies named entities with confidence scores

planner.role: Generate N branches (default 3) with stepwise plans and rationale. Each branch is a self-contained candidate path.
planner.system_prompt: SYSTEM: You are Planner Agent. Using perception metadata and the provided chunks, author N candidate branches with detailed steps for the session. Each branch must be independent, contain an estimated cost (time/LLM tokens), required actions, required agents, and a short rationale. Output strictly as JSON array named 'branches' following OUTPUT_SCHEMA.

inputs.description: references to chunk ids or params

edge_cases: Conflict with constraints: If branch violates constraints, do NOT include it; add rejection_reason field
Insufficient context: If recommended_chunks empty, request 3 extra retrieval attempts, create simplified branches
Resource heavy steps: Mark steps requiring heavy compute as heavy:true for worker pool scheduling
planner.validation_strategy: Ensure steps are not empty and cost_estimate.tokens present. If not, retry with instruction to produce concrete steps with estimated_tokens integer values
planner.retry_strategy: On validation failure, retry with simpler branch structure and fewer steps
planner.fallback_strategy: Generate single default branch with basic steps when all planning fails

branches.title: Detailed Mars lighthouse narrative
branches.rationale: Focus on world-building and character development for immersive story

steps.action: Extract setting details and atmosphere requirements
Generate 5-scene story outline with character arcs

unit_tests: test_planner_estimates_costs: verifies token and time estimates present

graph_manager.role: Maintain knowledge graph (nodes/edges), merge similar nodes, prune low-value nodes, serialize snapshots
graph_manager.system_prompt: SYSTEM: You are Graph Manager. When given new nodes/edges or branch updates, you must: 1) Insert or update nodes/edges into ArangoDB; if Arango unavailable, write into Mongo with identical schema. 2) Apply node-merge heuristics using embedding similarity (threshold configurable). 3) Prune nodes based on age/usage/score and update snapshot. Return only JSON conforming to OUTPUT_SCHEMA.

algorithms.node_merge: cosine similarity on embeddings using numpy + scipy.spatial.distance. If sim >= merge_threshold, propose merge
algorithms.prune_policy: importance = score * log(1+usage_count) - age_factor. Prune if below threshold
algorithms.backtracking: remove edges created after branch timestamp, optionally restore snapshot from /data/backups/{session_id}

edge_cases: No embeddings available: fall back to normalized token-overlap Jaccard similarity
Concurrent merges: use transactions (Arango supports). If fails, use version-controlled merges in Mongo
Large graph op batches: chunk ops into batches ≤ BATCH_SIZE to avoid DB transaction timeouts
graph_manager.validation_strategy: Verify inserted nodes have stable id format. If DB write fails, retry with exponential backoff (3 attempts)
graph_manager.retry_strategy: On DB failure, write to JSON fallback and mark node as pending_sync: true
graph_manager.fallback_strategy: Use in-memory graph representation when all database backends fail

payload.title: Mars Lighthouse
payload.text: Automated beacon structure on Mars surface

unit_tests: test_node_merge_threshold: two nodes with high similarity become merged
test_prune_policy: nodes with low importance pruned

verifier.role: Verify candidate branches for correctness, factuality, grammar, safety, and adherence to constraints
verifier.system_prompt: SYSTEM: You are Verifier Agent. Take a branch and its referenced chunks; verify: - Factual consistency with chunks - Grammar and readability - Safety & policy checks (e.g., PII, disallowed topics) Return single JSON per branch with reasons and suggested corrections.
edge_cases: Missing evidence in chunks: Mark as needs_revision and include evidence_needed references
Ambiguous facts (conflicting sources): Present both sources in issues with confidence low
PII or legal issues: immediate reject with severity=high
verifier.validation_strategy: Ensure accept_reject field present and confidence score provided
verifier.retry_strategy: If LLM-based verification times out, run lightweight rule-based verifier
verifier.fallback_strategy: Use regex for numbers/dates, cross-check names against chunks when LLM fails

steps.action: Create lighthouse character with Mars-specific adaptations

referenced_chunks.text: Mars atmosphere is 95% CO2, pressure 0.6% of Earth

unit_tests: test_verifier_detects_pii: identifies and flags PII content

evaluator.role: Score and rank branches based on multiple criteria (relevance, creativity, safety, cost), provide final ordering
evaluator.system_prompt: SYSTEM: You are Evaluator Agent. For an array of branches, compute multi-criteria scores and produce a composite ranking. Use scoring weights provided in input. Output JSON exactly matching schema.

scoring_rules.cost_penalty: Cost is negative weight - higher cost reduces composite score
scoring_rules.safety_override: If safety < 0.2, set recommended=false regardless of composite score
scoring_rules.tie_breaking: Use safety then relevance for tie breaking
scoring_rules.normalization: All scores normalized to 0-1 range before weighting

edge_cases: All branches fail safety: recommend none, provide explanation
Identical composite scores: apply tie-breaking rules consistently
Missing cost estimates: use default penalty value
evaluator.validation_strategy: Ensure ranked_branches not empty and ranks are consecutive integers starting from 1
evaluator.retry_strategy: If ranking fails, retry with simplified scoring (relevance + safety only)
evaluator.fallback_strategy: Use rule-based scoring when LLM evaluation fails
unit_tests: test_evaluator_rank_stable: deterministic ranking for identical inputs
test_evaluator_cost_penalty: higher cost reduces composite score

json_fixing.step_1: Run json.loads. If parsing fails, extract largest JSON-looking substring via regex and try parse
json_fixing.step_2: If still fails, call LLM again with: 'Previous response failed JSON validity. Produce only valid JSON matching this schema: {schema}. Do not add commentary.'
json_fixing.step_3: If after RETRY_MAX attempts still invalid, use FallbackLLM to create conservative structured output
json_fixing.backup: Write /data/backups/{session_id}/invalid_responses/attempt_{n}.json and mark in session logs

validation_policy.universal_validation: Always attach call_metadata with provider and attempt counts

performance_guidelines.concurrency: Use async TaskPool with max_workers. Schedule perception and chunking in parallel; Planner after perception completes
performance_guidelines.batching: Batch embedding requests and similarity checks; use einops for large embedding arrays
performance_guidelines.caching: Implement redis optional cache for recent chunk embeddings and top-k retrievals
performance_guidelines.streaming: Support streaming chunk by chunk to frontend via SSE/websockets for long generation

per_agent_requirements: Confirm call_metadata exists with provider and latency
Force error conditions: simulate provider timeouts, DB unavailability
Confirm fallback pathways: when provider fails, FallbackLLM used
integration_tests: test_full_orchestration: end-to-end with mocked LLMProvider and in-memory DBs
test_failure_recovery: graceful handling of component failures

operational_monitoring.alerts: If FallbackLLM used > X% in last 24h, create /admin/alerts/fallback_usage.json
